svg.title: Progress: 58 % of the functions work through the MCP
svg.desc: One square per function. 173 of 296 Solid Edge functions in the coverage map work through the MCP, 44 fail in Solid Edge 2026 and 79 are not tested yet. By area: Application, documents and data 36 of 58; Sketches and reference planes 16 of 24; Part (ordered modeling) 26 of 51; Synchronous modeling and surfaces 10 of 23; Sheet metal 13 of 27; Assemblies 21 of 44; Drawings 30 of 43; Program configuration 21 of 26.

g.font-family: Bahnschrift, 'DIN Alternate', 'DIN 1451', D-DIN, Barlow, 'Roboto Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif
g.text: of the 296 Solid Edge functions in the coverage map work through the MCP
